notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Verdurous Gearhulk.
description:
Activate Verdurous Gearhulk by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Verdurous Gearhulk enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator.
Resolve the Verdurous Gearhulk trigger, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing itself and Verdurous Gearhulk.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
